svg.title: TOPAK D1 — The admit path: decide, then order, then effect
svg.desc: Every effect an agent causes passes eight steps on one replica of the reference mechanism. Steps 1–6 decide against one state snapshot; step 7 orders the admit in the Paxos log and re-checks it at its log position; step 8 performs the effect, only after commit. Denials leave at every step and are recorded but never ordered. admit ⟺ floor_permit ∧ ¬bundle_deny (ADR-0030 §1). An operator's signed request and an emergency activation reach the log by the same decide, order and re-check, with no bundle tier (below the effect; ADR-0050 and ADR-0052, provisional).
svg.text: TOPAK · D1

text.tspan: The admit path: decide, then order, then effect

svg.text: Every effect an agent causes passes eight steps on one replica of the reference mechanism. Steps 1–6 decide against one state snapshot; step 7 orders the admit in the Paxos log and re-checks it at its log position; step 8 performs the effect, only after commit. Denials leave at every step and are recorded but never ordered. admit ⟺ floor_permit ∧ ¬bundle_deny (ADR-0030 §1). An operator's signed request and an emergency
activation reach the log by the same decide, order and re-check, with no bundle tier (below the effect; ADR-0050 and ADR-0052, provisional).

text.tspan: Built at reference · evidence · rung 0 as deployed

svg.text: The bearer token on the replica's agent socket names the seat, the lease (its fence, a log index) and the epoch; every action carries all three (ADR-0022 §2).
A launched guest has no token: at rung 1 the launcher's bridge is its session; under an attested session key each action carries the guest's session proof, checked
here against the action (I14, I41; ADR-0033 A7, ratified Batch 29).
An emergency seat has no token path (ADR-0052 §1, provisional): every action under its lease carries a proof signed with the person's key, checked here and at
apply. The agent socket's protocol carries no proof, so at the reference the person acts in-process (I48; G10 item 92).
SubmitWorkspace becomes Submit(digest) over the round workspace; an abstain from a Run seat is refused here, before ordering (ADR-0042 §5).
Names no principal and no round, so there is no round record for it: an authentication event
logged at this replica's socket (ADR-0003 A2 note; register G5).
Other: a bearer token used on an emergency seat's lease (ADR-0052 §1).
deny
The lease TTL runs on this replica's monotonic clock from when it applied the grant, read with the asymmetric margin, so it elapses early (ADR-0032 §2). No local
observation of the grant counts as expired: fail closed.
A race, fixed (ADR-0033 A13, Batch 33): the observation was recorded after the state lock was released, so a lease just granted could be ended as expired. It is now
recorded before (G10 §3, result 2).
A liveness check only. The fence in step 3 carries safety.
The replica also proposes EndRound(Expired): a subtraction, ordered so replicas agree, approved
by nobody (ADR-0033 §4; ADR-0031 E1).
deny

text.tspan: Mechanism checks: epoch fence, lease, alphabet

svg.text: check_live, in order: the lease is known and is this seat's; lease epoch = current epoch (the fence); request epoch = lease epoch; lease rules epoch = current rules
epoch; lease not ended; action in the lease's alphabet; round bound not reached; action preconditions (Submit once; Vote only on a submitted artifact whose gates
passed).
Then channel fidelity: under an attested lease whose Run profile says P4 passes, an Actuate naming a tool not hosted as Wasm is refused (channel_fidelity;
ADR-0034 A2, ratified Batch 30; ADR-0033 A8, Batch 31).
Mechanism, not policy: the floor never decides whether an epoch is current (ADR-0030 §4).
FencedEpoch, RequestEpochMismatch, FencedRulesEpoch, LeaseEnded, NotInAlphabet,
RoundBoundReached, ArtifactNotSubmitted, ArtifactAlreadySubmitted, GatesNotPassed,
EvidenceMismatch, AlreadyPromoted; WrongSeat (the token's lease is another seat's);
BadHeartbeat (a heartbeat from a non-observer, naming no round it watches, above what exists or
below its last watermark); Other, for a Run tool not held to its channel.
With steps 1, 2 and 4, sixteen MechanismDeny variants, unchanged by the 10.05 rebuild: its new
refusals are Other with a reason (state.rs).
deny
Mechanical and total: every fact is a set membership, an equality or a path-syntax check; nothing interprets meaning (ADR-0007, ADR-0018 validator side).
Principal, action, resource, context and the complete entity slice in schema S's shape, plus the bundle's view built from the same facts. Resolved once; the bundle
may not re-fetch (ADR-0030 §4). Its digest goes into the admit.
Label facts (ADR-0047 §4): for a Consult or Actuate the deciding replica computes, from the allowlist entry of the lease's revision and the round's labels, the round's
clearSet, the handles' labels, whether a destination is a literal, whether the entry is outward (derived, never declared: ADR-0049 §4), the result's label and its
delivery mode. They enter S as attributes; no policy computes one, and the admit carries them.
An emergency seat's call is decided against the revision that holds its entry in the envelope (ADR-0052 §2).
observerLive is live(o), computed here (ADR-0039 §1).
A request the lift cannot build is a mechanism deny: for Submit, an artifact that is not the workspace
digest.
Other: a handle that names nothing in this round for this principal (ADR-0049 §3); an Actuate with
no label facts, which is refused and not lifted as inside (ADR-0047 §4).
deny
floor/proposed/emergency-floor.cedar (28 policies, 107 cases), its schema and floor/genesis-values.json, compiled in by path; the replica refuses to start
unless their bytes match the gated digests (ADR-0033 §2). Since 2026.10.05 the reference links the proposed floor's last stage, not the genesis draft (G10
New entries: R5 to R7 forbid an outward Actuate over labels (read then send, steered destination, replayed content); B10 lets an emergency seat Actuate, admitted
by R1 over its envelope. X1-break-glass is retired: one exception, X2 (ADR-0041 A1 to A3; ADR-0052).
S is enforced on every request: a non-conforming input is a deny (ADR-0030 §4).
Floor([forbids that fired]), or FloorNoPermit: outside every envelope (finding 10).
FloorError: any evaluation error is a deny, since Cedar skips an erroring forbid (ADR-0030 §1).
The bundle is never consulted.
deny

text.tspan: Bundle: OPA sidecar | WASM · can only refuse

svg.text: data.topak.bundle.allow, counted only from the revision the lease names, and only if that revision's signature verified under the rules' bundle_keys (ADR-0044;
built, ADR-0033 A6).
A bundle loads only if its allowlist is well-formed (ADR-0049, W1 to W9 checked at load; I33); the bundle tier checks each handle among an Actuate's inputs
against the entry's accepts (ADR-0047 §3).
Sidecar unreachable or serving another revision → the in-process WASM engine decides iff it holds that revision; otherwise refuse. Every admit records which engine
decided.
Deny, error, undefined, absent or unreachable: anything but an affirmative true refuses. A bundle
is never asked whether to grant (ADR-0030 §1).
deny

text.tspan: Decide · the deciding replica, against one state snapshot (B2 membrane)

svg.text: floor permit ∧ bundle allow
Deciding and ordering are separated in time (ADR-0033 §4; ADR-0015 E1). The admit carries its decision, and the floor and bundle are not re-run at apply; the
mechanism state is.
Re-proposed under one id every 750 ms, up to
a 5 s deadline; the state machine applies an id
at most once.
Crash-recovery Multi-Paxos over 3 replicas;
promises and votes fsynced to the WAL before
any reply leaves (ADR-0033 §3).
check_live again at the log position; the
parameter digest; for Actuate/Report under a
Thinker, the deterministic half of live(o);
channel fidelity; for a Consult or Actuate, that
it carries label facts and that the round's
clearSet is still the one the floor was asked
about; under a session key, or an emergency
seat's person key, the proof with a fresh
counter.
Fails the re-check (fenced between decision and commit; decided under other parameters; no cell Observer covers the seat at commit; a Run tool not held to its channel;
decided against a clearSet the round has since grown past, refused and not re-decided (ADR-0047 §4); a Run delivery with no label; a proof that is not the attested
guest's or the person's, or a replayed counter): ordered, recorded, without effect. Applied::Rejected, returned as NotCommitted, and so recorded as a denial too.
An admit that applies folds its labels on every replica, in log order: an Actuate result's label by its seq, a Consult's by its reference, and either into clearSet when
it is delivered clear. clearSet only grows, and a reader with the log can recompute it (ADR-0047 §4). The fold is at admit, before the call returns: a failed call still adds
its label, which is sound and coarser than the record (I46 (b)). Apply re-checks clearSet and takes the other facts as the deciding replica's (G10 item 93).
re-check fails
The admit was voided at apply, or not committed before the 5 s deadline.
Ordering is not authorization: a void admit is in the log, and a denial still is not.
deny

text.tspan: Order · the Paxos log (P), the ordering authority
Effect: after commit, on the deciding replica only

svg.text: A crash between commit and effect leaves an admit with no effect, which is safe: absence of effect is not an event (ADR-0015). Effects are exactly {tool invocation,
principal emission}.
Bytes from the content-addressed corpus store, checked against their
address. Consult is ingress, no effect (ADR-0040).
A Consult's content is delivered clear with its label, or as a handle with no
bytes, by the delivery table for the seat's kind (ADR-0047 §2).
Write into the round-scoped workspace ws-<seat>-e<epoch>-r<round>, on
the deciding replica only (workspaces are not replicated, register G9).
A native tool: the tool host spawns name@digest, checks binary and schema
digests, cleared environment, workspace as cwd. Hermeticity is not checked
(G4), nor a native Run tool's channel (G19).
A hosted Wasm tool's one network capability is the target its allowlist entry
declares in the lease's revision, not node configuration (ADR-0033 A9;
A handle among the inputs is resolved here, on the mechanism's side: the
tool receives the bytes, the principal never does (ADR-0047 §3). Only a
scalar resolves (I46 (d)).
The result goes back clear with its label, or as a handle with no bytes and no
digest. The Actuate record (ADR-0042 §3): returned, failed or unknown;
seatKind where it said breakGlass (A2); four label fields (A1).
Written only after commit, carrying the admit's log index, the lease fence
and the per-lease sequence number (ToO §4.2).
The round opens with the tool list: at grant, before the session exists, the
mechanism writes an opening record with no admit and no sequence number
Topic topak.<chain>.<domain>.<seat>.e<epoch>.r<round> (ADR-0003
A1). Submit and Vote have no outside effect: the admit is the record (F3 for
a vote).

text.tspan: Effect · reaches the world only as an admit (B3 typed effect)

Regrant, Renew, AttestGates
add; EndRound, Revoke,

the operator seat's key, with the
fleet epoch and a counter
(ADR-0050 §3, §4). Checked
here, so a forgery is not ordered.
The replica computes thirteen
facts about the operator, the
target and the request (

and live, the binding, the round,
the alphabets, the task's label.
The operator supplies none.
lift_control into S.
No bundle tier: the nine control
entries are the whole envelope. A
deny is returned to the operator
with the floor's reasons and the
facts. A Regrant at rung 1 or
above is refused: it would launch
a guest, not built (G10 item 88).
Every replica verifies the
signature against the seat's key,
refuses a replayed counter,
refuses if they differ, and

ControlFacts::permitted).
Then it is written to the operator's

person, one round, the round's

of the break-glass roster sign

reason field: why the quorum
acted is unknown to the

The deciding replica computes

every Run entry of every revision

(b); G10 §3 result 5, item 92).
Others take it as given, except a

Every replica counts distinct

the task's label is within the
seating's; then grants one lease
and keeps the activation as the
F5 record.
No successor and no renewal: an
operator's Regrant or Renew
naming it is refused, and any
operator of the domain may end
or revoke it (ADR-0052 §3).
at apply: X1 is retired.

text.tspan: BOOTSTRAP: the unsigned socket stands in for the quorum

svg.text: Where the rules declare an operator, the unsigned socket is a BOOTSTRAP path that seats and does nothing else: an unsigned Grant or Launch is a first
seating; an unsigned renewal, operator end of round, revocation, fleet fence or gate attestation is refused at apply. A grant that keeps a seat's seated binding while two
operators of its domain are live is a successor, and theirs to make. prepare_emergency stands in for the promotion that prepares an emergency seating. A first lease
from a quorum is not built: whoever reaches the socket can seat (ADR-0050 §2; G10 §8). Rules that declare no operator leave the socket as it was: D-0050-1.

text.tspan: Two more paths into the log · decided, ordered, re-checked · no bundle tier
Denials are not ordered, and they are recorded

svg.text: A denied effect never crosses the boundary; a denial changes no state, so it is never proposed
Recorded (ADR-0020: the replayable record includes actions attempted and denied): written
unordered, by the deciding replica, content reduced to digests (ADR-0004), carrying at (the log
index the replica had applied) and decided_by, and logged locally with attribution.
Round open → the principal's round topic.
Round sealed → the round's after companion (ADR-0003 A2, confirmation-required C1): denials
only, same subject and round, erased with it; at most after_topic_limit records (dev: 64) per
deciding replica, the counter not being replicated (I23), then one overflow marker.
Finding 11: the reference first dropped this clause; review caught it (ToO §15).
Neither the ordering authority (the Paxos log) nor the system of record (the archive, not built).
ADR-0005 was ratified 2026.10.04 (Batch 27, C4): the debt ADR-0033 §2's K row carried is
discharged.
A reader orders a topic by the log index and sequence number its records carry, not by offsets
Kafka has no seal primitive: the mechanism refuses emission after the round ends and appends a
seal marker.
Readers nothing gates: the mechanism has no read path for topics, so who reads one is the
transport's configuration (G10 item 46).
deny records
emissions,
Actuate records,
opening record
An admit decided under epoch e can commit after a fence has moved the epoch on. The mechanism checks therefore run twice; the second run uses the state at the
entry's log position (ADR-0033 §4).
log / time
steps 1–6 pass under epoch e
FenceEpoch: epoch → e+1
apply re-runs check_live: FencedEpoch
ordered, recorded, no effect

text.tspan: What the log orders: ordering is not authorization

apply and the operator's signed Control carries them (ADR-0050 §4):
operator socket grant (rung 0); the
launcher, on launch (rung ≥ 1)

on every replica (A7); never an emergency seat's lease

No entry records a promotion. There is no Promote entry and no promote op: promotion happens inside apply when a Vote or Heartbeat admit completes the tally (
Applied::Admitted { promoted }), and Candidate.promoted_at in state is derived from that admit. F3 retains the vote; the promotion itself is a derived fact the
archive would have to recompute (inventory finding 29). Applied has fourteen results; the rebuild added EmergencyPrepared, and BreakGlassApproved is no longer
reachable.

text.tspan: at decide and at apply (ADR-0039 §1, §2, A2; ADR-0041 §2)

svg.text: At decide, the lift computes live(o) for the seat's cell Observers: a live Observer lease, a heartbeat heard within T_obs on this replica's clock, and seq(t)
− mark(o, r) < K. Floor entry R3-observer-live forbids Actuate and Report under a Thinker without it.
R3 is a Thinker's. An emergency seat is not a thinker and is not coupled: no exemption is written (ADR-0039 A2, provisional with ADR-0052).
At apply, only the deterministic half is re-checked: T_obs is a per-replica clock, so it cannot be (ToO §15, 2026.09.29 findings).
Consult is not coupled; an Observer's own heartbeats are not coupled. Values are placeholders (T_obs 5000 ms, K 8; floor/genesis-values.json).

text.tspan: The audit chain every effect carries (ToO §4.1; ADR-0015)

svg.text: effect → admit → floor ∧ bundle, at the lease's bundle revision → rules epoch → issuance → ADR-0025's intent axiom. No link is assumed except the last.
Each link is a field of the committed admit (below), which is forensic class F1 (ADR-0028).
The seat the session names
The lease's fence: the log index of its grant
The epoch the request carried
The admitted action with its target; for Actuate, the tool id, the inputs by digest, and whether the call is an emergency seat's (
emergency, F5), where it said whether the floor admitted it through X1-break-glass
Digest of the frozen input both tiers evaluated (ADR-0030 §4)
Digest of the linked floor text
Digest of schema S
Not recorded. The values file is pinned at startup beside the floor and schema (step 5), but no admit and no status reply carries its
digest (inventory finding 12)
The permitting policy ids
The bundle revision that allowed: the lease's, or for an emergency seat the one holding the entry
Which bundle engine decided: sidecar or local WASM
Digest of the mechanism parameters; a mismatch at apply voids the admit
The deciding replica, which alone performs the effect
Under an attested session key (rungs 2 and 3), the guest's proof that it sent this action; under an emergency seat's lease, the person's
For a Consult or Actuate, the label facts the deciding replica computed (ADR-0047 §4, §5); folded at apply. Apply re-checks
clearSet only and takes the rest as the replica's (I46 (a); G10 item 93)

text.tspan: Mechanism state: what the log rebuilds, and what each replica keeps alone (

svg.text: Replicated, rebuilt by replaying the log, never snapshotted: chain, epoch, rules, floor_exceptions, leases (by fence, each with its round's labels,
and for an emergency seat the person's key and the envelope), live_by_seat, last_round, candidates, gates, revoked, applied_ids (PROVISIONAL,
G14), last_applied, the floor's observer and persona values, marks, seals, profiles, contested; since 2026.10.05 seatings, last_lease,
control_ctr, emergency_seatings and activations. The break_glass approvals map is dead: no entry can add to it (I48).
Per replica, not replicated: sessions (the bearer tokens, I14), observed (recorded under the state lock since A13), heard(o) (ADR-0032 §3),
after_written (I23), in_flight Actuate calls, launched guests, and results, what a handle can name, held in memory and dropped at the seal (I46 (e)).
A replica that dies takes these with it; after a failover a handle to an earlier result fails its call.
82 traces, 1,007 steps, every step matching, and every state keeping ConfinementRefinement.tla's invariants (
spec/Mechanism-trace-results-2026.10.05.txt).
The model's scope at A14: the label fold and the stale-clearSet refusal, a seating, the gate on unsigned requests, a control request with its facts
recomputed and the envelope restated, an activation, and X1's approval rejected. Five edits that each removed one modelled thing produced a mismatch; a
sixth is caught as an evaluation error.
Taken from the trace, not computed: whether a request's signature is its seat's, whether a sign-on assertion verifies, which roster keys approved an
activation, which seat a revocation was lifted on, and the label facts themselves.
The floor's decision on an operator's request is not modelled: the trace compares two restatements of the envelope, in Rust and in TLA+, and neither
with the Cedar text. A matching trace is drift detection on tested paths, not a refinement; T-0045-28 stands.

text.tspan: What this path does not show (ADR-0033 §1, §3, §6; G10 §8)

svg.text: Confinement: for an operator grant the MCP front door makes the alphabet the whole protocol, not the whole channel. The launcher (A7, ratified Batch 29)
makes it the whole channel for a guest it starts, at rung 1 on profiles that declare P3 fail, or at rung 3 only SIMULATED: no real principal is Contained.
A first lease from a quorum: seatings are made by the BOOTSTRAP path (G10 item 88).
That a label is true: the facts are one replica's computation, a failed call's error text reaches the principal unlabelled, and only a scalar can be passed by
handle (G10 item 93).
A person's signed action on a socket: an emergency seat is exercised in-process (G10 item 92).
A Byzantine replica: replicas are crash-recovery. The apply re-check stops stale admits, not forged ones; replica authentication is unbuilt (T-0045-1).
The reference is evidence, not the verified object: never promoted, in no TCB.
